title: Medical Records Requests — Register of Request Types and Entry Conditions
content:
Medical Records Requests are held one release at a time, and every request is opened as exactly one of seven request types. Each type has its own entry conditions, and a request is opened under a type only when all of that type's conditions hold.

## Register

| Rank | Request type | Entry conditions (all must hold) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Portal Self-Service Download | The patient's portal account is active; the requester is the patient. |
| 2 | Patient Electronic Copy Request | The requester is the patient or a personal representative; the requester's identity is verified. |
| 3 | Patient Paper Copy Request | The requester is the patient or a personal representative; the requester's identity is verified. |
| 4 | Provider-to-Provider Transfer | The recipient is a treating provider; the request is made by the patient or by a provider. |
| 5 | Third-Party Authorized Release | A signed authorization is on file; the recipient is named on the authorization. |
| 6 | Certified Legal Records Package | A signed authorization or a subpoena is present; certification is requested. |
| 7 | Imaging Disc Copy Request | The imaging study was performed in the group; the requester's identity is verified. |

## Identity and age figures by request type

Identity verification means the requester's identity must be verified before release. The minimum self-request age is the youngest patient who may request their own records without a guardian, in years.

| Request type | Identity verification required | Minimum self-request age (years) |
|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | Yes | 18 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Yes | 18 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Yes | 18 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | 0 (no minimum age) |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | Yes | 18 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | Yes | 18 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | Yes | 18 |

## Points of judgement

- **Compound conditions.** Every entry condition in a row is required. For a Patient Electronic Copy Request, a requester who is the patient but whose identity is not verified does not meet the type's conditions; neither does a verified requester who is neither the patient nor a personal representative.
- **The Certified Legal Records Package** accepts either a signed authorization or a subpoena as its first condition, and in both cases certification must also be requested.
- **The Provider-to-Provider Transfer** turns on the recipient, not the requester: the recipient must be a treating provider, and the request may come from the patient or from a provider.
- **Age figures, hypothetically applied.** Under any type showing 18, a patient aged 18 is at the figure and may request their own records without a guardian, while a patient aged 17 is below it. The Provider-to-Provider Transfer shows 0, so no patient is below its figure.
